notes: the envelope digest binds six elements: request id, answer payload digest, asserted claim set, full claim set, evidence sentence ids, issuance snapshot; it makes an honestly issued certificate tamper-evident (a deployment would sign the digest)
tamper classes: M1 payload substitution, M2 claim-set laundering, M3 asserted-set laundering, M4 sentence substitution, M5 issuance forward-dating, M6 cross-request replay
the independent verifier reads only the transferred JSONL envelopes plus the state-provider view; integrity and binding checks run before contract evaluation
